title: One persist function for chat turns
evidence: Survey 2026-11-25: the three write sites differ in client (web: user-scoped createUserClient; bots: supabaseAdmin), timing (web writes conversation and question before the model call and fails the turn on either; bots write after the reply), conversation lookup (web: create; Discord: create if none; YouTube: find-or-create by comment id), answer-row failure (web and Discord: no event; YouTube: event with null message_id), timestamp touch (web and Discord yes; YouTube no) and error reporting. Only the row mappings are shared, and chat-persist.server.ts already holds them. One persistChatTurn would need about seven options, so it was not built; the pins (US-15 AC70) guard the move S-1 makes. Recommendation: fold the shared write into S-1, which must first rule on the answer-row failure path.
